name: @pipeworx/mcp-firecrawl

tools.name: scrape
tools.description: Scrape a single URL using Firecrawl's JS-rendering engine and return clean markdown (up to 100,000 chars), page title, and description. Strips navigation/boilerplate by default (only_main_content=true). Supports output formats: markdown, html, rawHtml, links.

formats.description: Output formats to return (default ["markdown"]). Options include "markdown", "html", "rawHtml", "links".

only_main_content.description: Strip navigation, footers, and boilerplate, returning just the main content (default true).

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Firecrawl API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: map
tools.description: Crawl a website and return all discovered URLs (up to 5,000). Optionally filter by a search term to rank discovered links by relevance. Returns {url, count, links[]}.

url.description: The website URL to map, e.g. "https://example.com"

search.description: Optional search term to filter discovered URLs by relevance.

limit.description: Maximum number of URLs to return (default 100, max 5000).

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Firecrawl API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Run a web search via Firecrawl and return ranked results with URL, title, and description snippet. Takes a query string and optional limit (default 5, max 20). Returns {query, results[{url, title, description}]}.

query.description: The search query, e.g. "best open-source vector databases".

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 5, max 20).

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Firecrawl API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-firecrawl forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the firecrawl pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
